I came in yesterday to exchange a pair of clippers that I purchased from another location because this location was closer to me and I was at work. The pair of clippers in question were bough a week ago, nothing wrong with them but they just weren’t powerful enough and I needed a stronger pair. The gentlemen with locs pulled up my receipt in the system with my phone number since I didn’t have the physical one, he then instructed me to grab a card for the clippers I want to exchange them for. As I returned from the clipper aisle I find an assistant manager looking through the contents of the clippers I want to exchange, everything is in the box. The assistant manager proceeds to look me up and down and then say “well I don’t feel comfortable exchanging these since I can’t verify the date of your purchase so you need to find the receipt or go back to the store you bought them from” I asked “well can we just call the other store to verify cause I’m not really able to go there now and I need to go back to work” she abruptly said “well that’s not gonna do nothing for us” with a shrug. I let to my car to go find the receipt and sneakily she says “bye have a good day” ATP I’m curious what she’s so raw about. Still can’t find the recipt but I go back inside because I remembered that the receipts don’t even populate in the system if they are older than the 60 day time frame to return/exchange so her comment about not being able to verify the date is bull. If you’re going to lie just to make someone’s day harder maybe come up with a better one. The young man grabs the assistant manager again for me and I tell her I need an exchange because she has my receipt in the computer and 60 days blah blah. She is upset with me and telling me that it doesn’t matter and it’s based on if she feels like exchanging it or not. I ask what her problem is????? And she pages her manager over the walkie “can you come tell this customer I’m not going to exchange these clippers she’s over here doing too much” which is extremely unprofessional imo. He comes over and I explain the issue to him and he begins to help me out no problem. Except he did a return and not an exchange so he asked to change me the full price of the clippers I wanted. I had to reiterate myself and tell him that I was counting on and EXCHANGE because I only had the difference for the clippers. He fixes the problem gives me the clippers I need. I get in my car open the box of clippers that’s taped up because It looked used and sure enough there were white hairs in stuck in the clipper and guard combs missing from the box. So not only did I go into this Petsmart and get treated poorly for seemingly no reason by a complete stranger, I paid full price for an incomplete and USED set of clippers. Idk maybe don’t go here unless you just need to do a simple transaction because you will apparently be punished if you need anything more.
